notes: Atomic image primitive — photos, illustrations, decorative SVGs, logos. Icon SVGs use Icon.astro. All 4 renders use the same Image.astro — pipeline strips animation props in reduced (no hover/tilt classes emitted). Textonly render keeps the image in the a11y tree but the alt text display system (data-alt-display-mode) controls visual presentation. Consumes theme tokens (--media-brightness, --media-saturation, --media-contrast) so monochrome/dark/high-contrast themes apply automatically. PIPELINE RULE: Images with AAC data (altAacHtml, altAacCards) are ALWAYS informational content — never stripped in any render mode. AAC cards are the accessible representation of the image. Decorative images (role=decorative) emit no HTML in textonly render — no CSS hide, just don't emit, so layout flows naturally with no gaps.

content._description: What the image shows and how it's described

src.description: Image URL from CDN or local path.

contentAlt.description: Standard alt text for screen readers. Pipeline content key.

role.description: Content wraps in

contentAltWord.description: Short word-level alt text. Pipeline content key.

contentAltDescriptive.description: Long descriptive alt text. Pipeline content key.

contentAltAacHtml.description: DEPRECATED — use contentAltAacCards. Pre-rendered AAC card HTML.

contentAltAacCards.description: Array of AacCardData objects. Pipeline content key.

semanticRole.description: Required. Declares intent — pipeline uses this to show/hide per render mode. Default: decorative (hidden in textonly/calm).

width.description: Image width. Uses --media-* em tokens. 'full' = 100% container.

height.description: Image height. Uses --media-* em tokens. 'auto' = aspect ratio.

border.description: Border thickness. Colour from color variant.

maskIcon.description: Phosphor icon slug for mask shape (fetched from Asset Library API).

maskShape.description: Shape slug for mask (shape-001 to shape-072, fetched from Asset Library API).

color.description: Colour variant for border, caption, background.

animation._description: Motion behaviour — gated by .image--animate class (no prop = no class = no motion)
